records.label: A140-01 · Reactor count, batch and cycle basis
records.status: DBM V2.0 basis approved — sizing withdrawn
records.detail: D-A140-01 approves the DBM V2.0 basis — 500 kg graphite per R-141 batch (batch sizes of PFD V5.1.1), 2.3 batches/day nominal and 3.0 design, two operating reactors plus one spare (rule C-05) — and withdraws the MEB-003 V16 / LST-005 sizing (80 kg/h, 543 kg per batch, 7 h cycle, 3 batches/day; 6.12 / 8.16 m³ vs LST-005 7.87 / 10.49 m³ vs REP-040 5.4 / 6.8 m³), the batch masses, the 593.6 kg Pre-G per batch (DBM: 550 kg per R-201 batch) and every thermal duty. The cycle is 7 h (MEB-003) vs 10 h (PFD / Narrative) vs 9–10 h (REP-040 with the cool-down leg removed) and follows the hot-transfer decision. The model shows four reactors A–D; the DBM count is 2 + 1.
records.action: Re-issue FEED-PE-MEB-003 (V17) on DBM V2.0 — 500 kg per batch, 2 + 1 reactors, 9–10 h cycle with P₂O₅ on heat-up and hot transfer — then fix the R-141 vessel size and reconcile the model's fourth reactor with the register.

records.label: A140-02 · Reaction envelope, P₂O₅ on heat-up and hot transfer
records.status: Approved — MoC on PFD sheets 0140 / 0160 required
records.detail: Approved (D-A140-02, MEB-003 / REP-040): 80 °C hold for 4.5 h; 18.4 kg H₂SO₄, 0.50 kg K₂S₂O₈ and 0.50 kg P₂O₅ per kg graphite; P₂O₅ dosed during heat-up so its ≈ 400 MJ supplies ≈ 45 % of the heat-up duty; hot transfer at 80 °C to T-161 (PFD 10–20 °C superseded); utility basis HWS 95 °C / CW 25–30 °C with chilled water no longer needed once the cool-down leg is removed. REP-040 halves the 317 kW heat-up duty with P₂O₅ credit; the 83.8 kW jacket cooling rests on an assumed 50 kW exotherm.
records.action: Raise the MoC on FEED-PE-PFD-001 sheets 0140 / 0160 for hot transfer and P₂O₅-on-heat-up; confirm T-161 water inlet ≤ 28 °C keeps T-161 below 50 °C (REP-042); carry the envelope into LST-007 and the C&E matrix.

records.label: A140-03 · Persulfate exotherm and temperature safeguards
records.detail: D-A140-02 adopts REP-040's worst credible case — +54 K adiabatic rise to ≈ 135 °C if the whole reactive inventory releases; hazards chemical, not pressure — as the safety design statement pending calorimetry, and records the 82 / 85 / 88 / 90 °C interlock ladder as a candidate of unstated origin. D-A140-01 withdrew the 83.8 kW jacket cooling capacity (assumed 50 kW exotherm) and the bounded 90–420 MJ persulfate oxidation as unmeasured (REP-040 F-06).
records.action: Run persulfate calorimetry on the design recipe (F-06); confirm the ladder and the jacket capacity in HAZOP / LOPA; record the origin of each setpoint.

records.label: A140-04 · Reagent charging — CH-141 / CH-142 identity and materials
records.detail: LST-001 and MAT-002 M-005 list T-141, T-142, SF-141 and SF-142 (316L dry-contact with PFA / PTFE-lined drop tubes, ruled by D-A140-MOC); the model owns one "Dedicated reagent charging stations" record CH-141 / CH-142 (equipment 43, 1,200 parts) with a geometry-only CH-141 — in the assembled model this is two charging hoppers with feeders on top of each reactor, eight in all (image 01), not two shared stations. P-141 is ruled PFA / ETFE-lined sealless with SiC bearings; the model's P-PG141 synthesis collection pump has no register identity. The four reactor jackets are provisional model subassemblies without register tags; the two emergency stations are model-only.
records.action: Split CH-141 / CH-142 into the four register tags or record the alias by decision; add P-PG141 to LST-001 or map it to P-141; decide whether jackets stay subassemblies.

records.label: A140-05 · Independent containment and access
records.detail: The model owns four independent bunds BND-141A–D (16.4 m³ retention each), two emergency stations (ES-141, ES-140-03) and fire point FE-141 at the synthesis approach; none is on LST-001. The reactors are glass-lined carbon steel with glass-lined agitator and wetted internals (MAT-002, D-A140-MOC). Retention volumes are model annotations; the hot-transfer decision changes the liquor temperature the bunds may receive.
records.action: Verify retention against the 500 kg batch inventory at 80 °C in the containment review; assign register identities to bunds, stations and fire point or record them by decision.
